idea-plugin.name: LDAP Client
idea-plugin.description:
A complete LDAP browser and editor inside your IDE. Works with any LDAPv3 server, such as OpenLDAP, Active Directory, 389 Directory Server or OpenDJ. Browse very large directories, search, edit entries with schema-aware editors, and run LDIF scripts without leaving the IDE. All directory operations run in the background, so the UI never freezes.

Connections

  • Manage any number of connections in the LDAP tool window, shown directly as tree roots (like the Database tool window). Connected servers are highlighted.
  • Reorder connections with drag and drop or Move Up / Move Down.
  • Plain LDAP, LDAPS or StartTLS, with optional hostname verification or trusting all certificates for test servers.
  • Anonymous or simple bind. Passwords are stored in the IDE password safe, never in settings files.
  • Base DNs can be fetched from the server's naming contexts. You can also set the page size, timeouts and connection pool size.
  • Read-only connections protect production servers from accidental changes.
  • Test Connection button in the connection dialog.

Efficient tree navigation

  • Children are loaded page by page with the Simple Paged Results control. A Load more… node fetches the next page, so containers with hundreds of thousands of entries open instantly.
  • Idle cursors release their connection and resume transparently.
  • Per-node child filters, for example (uid=a*).
  • Icons for people, groups, organizational units and domains.

Search

  • Base, one-level or subtree scope, with an attribute list and a size limit.
  • The filter editor has syntax highlighting and completes attribute and object class names from the server schema.
  • Recent filters are remembered. Searches can be saved and re-run in one click.
  • Results stream into a spreadsheet-style table in the LDAP Results tool window. Cancelled searches are abandoned on the server.
  • Export results to LDIF, bulk modify the selected or all results (add, replace or delete attribute values), or compare two results.

Entry editor

  • Spreadsheet-style attribute grid with multi-valued attributes grouped together.
  • Required attributes are marked. Attributes not allowed by the entry's object classes are underlined.
  • Tooltips show the description, syntax and single- or multi-valued flag from the schema.
  • Pending changes are highlighted and saved in a single modify request, with an optional LDIF preview before saving.
  • Dedicated value editors:
    • Passwords: hashing with SSHA-512 / SSHA-256 / SSHA / SHA / SMD5 / MD5, plain text, or Active Directory unicodePwd. You can generate a password and verify the current one.
    • Binary values: hex dump, image preview (jpegPhoto), X.509 certificate details, objectGUID / objectSid decoding, and load from or save to file.
    • DN, integer, boolean and generalized time values, each with validation.
  • Optional display of operational attributes.
  • Ctrl+Click (⌘+Click) on DN values such as member, memberOf or manager opens the referenced entry.

Entry operations

  • Create entries from LDIF or from a template generated from the chosen object classes.
  • Duplicate, rename and delete entries, including recursive subtree delete.
  • Copy or move an entry or a whole subtree, on the same connection or to another one (for example from staging to production). You choose what happens on conflicts.
  • Compare two entries in the IDE diff viewer, even across servers.
  • Group membership: show an entry's groups, including nested ones, and a group's members, including Active Directory ranged values and dynamic groupOfURLs.
  • Account status for Active Directory, OpenLDAP ppolicy and 389 DS: see whether an account is disabled, locked out or has an expired password. You can unlock it, disable or enable it, or require a password change.

Schema browser

  • Object classes, attribute types, matching rules and syntaxes with a filter and cross-links.
  • Shows the inherited required and optional attributes of a class, and where an attribute type is used.

LDIF

  • Run LDIF scripts from a file or straight from the editor, including unsaved text and selections (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X / ⌘⌥⇧X).
  • Supports add, modify, delete, modrdn / moddn and controls. Records without a changetype can be added or added-or-replaced.
  • Options to continue after errors or stop at the first one, and a validate-only dry run.
  • Per-record results; double-click a result to jump to its line in the script.
  • Export an entry, its children or a whole subtree. The export is streamed to disk and written parents-first, so it can be imported back directly.
  • LDIF syntax highlighting.

Safety and auditing

  • An optional change preview shows the exact LDIF before it is sent, with passwords masked.
  • The operation log lists every add, modify, delete and rename with its result and LDIF. It can be exported as an LDIF script.
  • Settings are under Settings | Tools | LDAP Client.
